primer: Aurobindo Pharma runs global generics, API, Pen-G, and biologics plants. It posted ₹33,653 Cr FY26 sales, record ₹10,263 Cr Q2 FY27 sales, and ₹3,002 Cr net cash. Clean Nov 2026 Apitoria API clearances are offset by four OAI/WL formulation sites, Pen-G's Jan 2027 MIP cliff, and MDL 2724 risk. At ₹1,843.00 live TV CMP (₹1,796.50 NSE ledger on 2026-11-23), our ₹1,850.00 base target gives 0.03:1 R/R at CMP and 0.66:1 at support. New capital is REJECTED on valuation, while 15 Zerodha shares stay HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP at ₹1,599.40.
